paragraphs: We are a high-performance cloud storage platform for data-intensive use cases in the artificial intelligence ("AI") era and across a broad range of modern cloud workloads, designed to help customers address complex storage needs by reducing the barriers of lock-in, complexity, and cost. Our mission is to make customers succeed by solving their toughest data storage challenges. We aim to achieve this mission through our purpose-built, web-scale software infrastructure, which is essential to the global data center and compute infrastructure buildout.

We provide cloud services through a purpose-built, web-scale software infrastructure built on commodity hardware. We believe that by offering a cloud storage solution optimized for price-to-performance at scale, engineered for efficiency, and priced predictably, we substantially reduce the cost, complexity and frustration of storing, using, and protecting data, and we empower customers to focus on their core business operations. Customers use us to support their AI workflows, help ensure the cyber-resilience of their organizations, streamline their media workflows, and enable a variety of other data-focused application and information technology ("IT") needs. Through our blog and culture of transparency, we have built a community of millions of readers and brand advocates. Our direct sales activities, channel and technology partners, and referrals from our community of brand advocates, combined with our highly efficient and self-serve customer acquisition model have allowed us to attract over 500,000 customers as of December 31, 2025, and our direct sales activities have historically supported us in acquiring larger customers, including leading neocloud platforms via our Powered by Backblaze program. As we move up-market, we expect our direct sales activities to increasingly contribute to the acquisition of customers like these. Our customers use our Backblaze Storage Cloud platform across more than 175 countries to store and protect their data with an aggregate of approximately 5 billion gigabytes of data storage under management.

At its founding, Backblaze set out to dramatically simplify the process of storing, using, and protecting data. Over the following years, we focused relentlessly on cutting away the complexity common among traditional cloud vendors' services and legacy on-premises system vendors. Today, we believe that our solutions are differentiated by their performance and cost efficiency while also delivering reliability and ease of use. Our strategy centers on a focused set of storage use cases and participation in an open cloud ecosystem, which we believe positions us to prioritize opportunities with emerging data-heavy workloads like those with AI model builders and neocloud platforms utilizing our Powered by Backblaze program. Alongside these emerging opportunities, we continue to grow our business and opportunities among the developers of application storage solutions while also continuing to service our foundational use cases including media and entertainment and cyber resilience. Finally, we continue to invest in our self-serve user base, where developers who are experimenting with AI can experiment and grow within our storage platform.

The Backblaze Storage Cloud provides the core platform for our cloud services and is designed to deliver high-performance, secure, reliable object storage at exabyte scale. It currently manages over 1 trillion files which are available on demand and is designed to scale efficiently to meet growing enterprise workloads and AI-driven data demands. The key enabler of the Backblaze Storage Cloud is its proprietary global-scale system and software architecture, which manages our global physical infrastructure, including hundreds of thousands of hard drives across multiple data centers.

The web-scale software layer receives, stores, and delivers data for customers across the globe, intelligently allocating storage based on capacity and demand to maintain availability and durability at scale. Managing ever-growing volumes of data across increasingly large hard drives while maintaining durability, availability, and throughput is highly complex. We believe that continued investment in developing performance optimization, efficiency improvements, operational support, and other software innovation enhances our ability to efficiently leverage hardware and scale cost-effectively. Alongside these core processes, this software architecture manages load balancing, caching, deletion, billing, and other essential

functions for hundreds of thousands of customers. Regular updates to our codebase further strengthen these capabilities and improve the overall performance of our Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform ("IaaS").

Our vault architecture creates redundancy for the storage of customer data using proprietary and other algorithms. Our software splits each uploaded customer file into several data parts, adds multiple redundant parts, and stores these parts across discrete hard drives in different servers in a data center. As a result, even if a few of the parts are entirely lost or offline, we are able to reconstruct the customer data from the remaining parts for durability and availability. Our globally distributed storage platform also offers customers multi-region geographic choice for their data, including East and West Coast regions in the United States, as well as regions in Canada, and Europe, providing flexibility for different needs including geopolitical considerations, regulatory requirements, and performance optimization.

As our customers' data needs grow, we seek to continuously and smoothly deploy additional infrastructure and utilize finance leases to align capital deployment with platform scaling requirements. These ongoing investments are designed to support high sustained throughput relative to price, while performing at levels that we believe are at or above competitors' performance across a range of metrics, including upload and download throughput for multiple file sizes and concurrency profiles. We periodically publish performance testing results and our performance testing methodologies to enhance transparency and enable benchmarking against other cloud storage providers.

Through our Backblaze Storage Cloud platform, we deliver two primary services, B2 Cloud Storage and Computer Backup, which are designed to enable customers to store, use, and protect their data in flexible and cost-effective ways. These services leverage the same core software architecture, allowing us to serve a broad spectrum of customers, from individual users to large enterprises, with consistent performance, security, and reliability.

B2 Cloud Storage provides customers with direct access to the Backblaze Storage Cloud platform, enabling them to store, use and protect data for a broad range of use cases. Users can access this platform through industry standard and native application programming interfaces, software development kits, our web interface, or hundreds of third-party integrations. The wide range of options for accessing B2 Cloud Storage allow for broad use, including developers and partners who can integrate storage capabilities into their technology stack or build their own solutions on top of our platform. Customers also strategically tier backups of their core data systems to the Backblaze Storage Cloud platform, including on-premises and virtual machine servers and other high-capacity storage devices.

Businesses are increasingly incorporating B2 Cloud Storage, including our premium high-throughput offering, B2 Overdrive, into AI and machine learning ("ML") workflows, ensuring data accessibility, scalability, and efficient network performance. From raw data collection and processing, to model training and inference, B2 Cloud Storage is designed to provide a reliable foundation for managing vast datasets, enable seamless data transfer to graphics processing unit ("GPU") clusters, optimize storage for AI-generated outputs, and provide cost-effective, scalable storage for monitoring and logs. B2 Overdrive is built on the foundation of B2 Cloud Storage, and includes throughput up to 1Tbps, unlimited free egress, and private networking support, designed to give customers the ability to run data-intensive workloads without compromising on performance to keep costs manageable. This flexibility allows customers to leverage best-of-breed compute GPU services without vendor lock-in, and significantly reduces data transfer costs, maximizing resource utilization and minimizing overall expenses.

Customers leverage B2 Cloud Storage for a wide range of other use cases, including public, hybrid and multi-cloud data storage; application development and DevOps; content delivery and edge computing; security and ransomware protection; media management; backup, archive and tape replacement; and Internet of Things (e.g., storing data for surveillance systems, autonomous vehicles, and smart devices). In multi-cloud environments typical of AI and data-intensive workloads, customers frequently move large volumes of data across cloud providers, which can create operational complexity and result in significant data egress fees. B2 Cloud Storage's open platform and standard free egress (up to 3x of data stored) are designed to enable cost-efficient multi-cloud architectures and seamless data orchestration across diverse cloud environments.
B2 Cloud Storage operates as an IaaS model, enabling customers to scale up and down as needed on a pay-as-you-go basis or to purchase capacity or committed contracts for greater predictability.

Our Computer Backup cloud service solution backs up laptops, desktops, and external hard drives in a continuous and automated fashion. Whether for home computers or a business' full fleet of machines, customers can back up a virtually unlimited number of files without size or speed constraints. Computer Backup offers transparent, flat-rate pricing to allow customers to continuously back up data and is delivered as a subscription-based Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") model.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry
We have a history of cumulative losses, and we do not expect to be profitable for the foreseeable future.
The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results would be harmed.
Any significant disruption in our service or loss, or delay in availability of our customers' data, could damage our reputation and harm our business and operating results.
If we are unable to maintain our brand and reputation, our business, results of operations, and financial condition may be adversely affected.
If our information technology systems, including the data of our customers stored in our systems, are breached or subject to cybersecurity attacks, our reputation and business may be harmed.
If we are unable to attract and retain customers on a cost-effective basis, our revenue and operating results would be adversely affected.
If we are unable to provide successful enhancements, new features, and modifications to our cloud services, our business could be adversely affected.

Material defects or errors in our software or hardware failures could negatively impact our business, harm our reputation, result in significant costs to us, and negatively impact our ability to sell our cloud services.
If we fail to effectively manage our workforce and operational needs, our business would be harmed.
Our business could be materially harmed to the extent that we do not effectively manage our data center capacity and the costs associated with our data center spaces.
Our business depends on our ability to retain and increase revenue from customers, and if we are unable to do so, our revenue and operating results would be adversely affected.
To the extent we target different types of customers, we may face increased demands and challenges that adversely impact our business and operations.
The material stored using our cloud services may subject us to negative publicity, legal liability, and harm our business.
Our quarterly results may fluctuate significantly and may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business.

We rely on the performance of key personnel, including our management and other key employees, and the loss of one or more of such personnel, or of a significant number of our team members, could harm our business.
The failure to attract and retain additional qualified personnel could prevent us from executing our business strategy.

Our corporate culture has contributed to our success, and if we cannot maintain this culture as we grow, we could lose the innovation, creativity, and teamwork fostered by our culture, and our business may be harmed.

Our operations and those of our customers, vendors and suppliers outside the United States, are subject to increased business, regulatory and economic risks that could impact our results of operations.

If any of these risks actually occur, it may materially harm our business, financial condition, liquidity, results of operations, and the market price of our Class A common stock.

Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our Class A common stock speculative or risky. Importantly, this summary does not address all of the risks that we face. Our ability to execute our business strategy is subject to numerous risks, as more fully described in the section titled "Risk Factors" immediately following this summary. These risks include, among others:
• We have a history of cumulative losses, and we do not expect to be profitable for the foreseeable future.
• The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results would be harmed.
• Any significant disruption in our service or loss, or delay in availability, of our customers' data, could damage our reputation and harm our business and operating results.
• If we are unable to maintain our brand and reputation, our business, results of operations, and financial condition may be adversely affected.

We believe that by offering a cloud storage solution optimized for price-to-performance at scale, engineered for efficiency, and priced predictably, we substantially reduce the cost, complexity and frustration of storing, using, and protecting data, and we empower customers to focus on their core business operations. Our customers use our Backblaze Storage Cloud platform across more than 175 countries to store and protect their data with an aggregate of approximately 5 billion gigabytes of data storage under management.

Our Backblaze Storage Cloud provides a platform that is the foundation for our B2 Cloud Storage Infrastructure-as-a-Service ("IaaS") offering, our B2 Overdrive high-performance IaaS offering, our Powered by Backblaze white label IaaS offering, and our Computer Backup Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") offering. B2 Cloud Storage enables customers to store data, developers to build applications, and partners to expand their use cases. The amount of data stored in this cloud service can scale up and down as needed primarily on a pay-as-you-go basis or can be paid for on a capacity or committed contract basis for greater predictability. Powered by Backblaze is also built on the foundation of B2 Cloud Storage. It enables neocloud and application platforms to bolster existing products or expand their product offerings with cloud storage via the Backblaze Partner API and custom domains (CNAME) technology. Computer Backup automatically backs up data from laptops and desktops for businesses and individuals. This cloud backup service offers easily understood primarily flat-rate pricing to continuously back up a virtually unlimited amount of data.

We focus on specialized storage and an open cloud ecosystem that integrates with a broad range of partners. Ongoing investment in our technology platform and related features has driven customer, community, and product milestones. Starting in the second half of 2024, we initiated a go-to-market transformation that is actively moving the company up-market, which has been evidenced by the signing of multiple deals with total contract values over $1.0 million each and revenue growth for B2 Cloud Storage of 26% for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to 2024.

To support our up-market expansion and evolving customer needs, we recently launched B2 Overdrive, our premium-priced, ultra high-throughput performance cloud storage solution, designed to meet the demands of data-intensive workloads including AI and machine-learning training, large-scale analytics, high-performance computing, and media processing. We also introduced a suite of enterprise cyber security features including AI-powered anomaly alerts, mandatory multifactor authentication, bucket access logging, and Enterprise Web Console which streamlines role-based administrative control in complex environments to help with cybersecurity and account management. These launches expand our addressable market among enterprise and AI-driven customers and lay the groundwork for further innovation to drive differentiated value for these customers.

On June 4, 2025, we entered into a credit agreement with Citizens Bank, N.A., establishing a senior secured revolving credit facility with a total borrowing capacity of up to $20.0 million to be used for general corporate purposes and working capital needs. As of December 31, 2025, the Company had no outstanding borrowings under this facility.
2025 Restructuring and Transformation Plan

In November 2025, we initiated a restructuring and transformation plan designed primarily to improve efficiency and enhance the performance of our sales and marketing functions to support our go-to-market initiatives (the "2025 Restructuring and Transformation Plan"). The 2025 Restructuring and Transformation Plan includes the reallocation of resources, the redesign of sales and marketing strategies and processes, and other corporate actions. During the year ended December 31, 2025, we incurred charges of approximately $2.5 million, including employee termination expenses, an impairment charge related to our exit from our corporate headquarters facility, and other transformation costs. We expect to incur additional charges of approximately $4.7 million to $7.5 million through the first quarter of 2027, at which time the 2025 Restructuring Plan is expected to be completed. These charges include estimated employee termination expenses of approximately $0.8 million to $1.2 million, and other business transformation costs.

In August 2025, our Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program authorizing us to repurchase up to $10.0 million of our Class A common stock through August 1, 2026. The program is intended to offset dilution resulting from stock-based compensation. Repurchases are to be funded from the proceeds of employee stock option exercises and from employee contributions under the 2021 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

require high sustained throughput and low latency. Developers and partners can embed our storage into their applications, while enterprise customers use B2 Cloud Storage to support large-scale, data-intensive workflows.

paragraphs: 本公司為一高性能雲端儲存平台，專為人工智慧（"AI"）時代及現代雲端工作負載的廣泛應用場域而設計，旨在協助客戶解決複雜的儲存需求，透過降低鎖定、複雜性與成本的門檻。本公司使命為協助客戶成功，解決他們最困難的資料儲存挑戰。本公司透過專為設計、網際網路規模的軟體基礎建設，實現此使命，此基礎建設為全球資料中心與計算基礎建設的建設所不可或缺。

本公司透過專為設計、網際網路規模的軟體基礎建設，建於一般性硬體之上，提供雲端服務。本公司相信，透過提供一項針對價格與效能比例最佳化、工程設計具效率，且價格可預測的雲端儲存解決方案，我們大幅降低儲存、使用與保護資料的成本、複雜性與煩惱，並使客戶能專注於其核心業務運作。客戶使用本公司服務以支援其AI工作流程，確保其組織的網路韌性，簡化其媒體工作流程，並啟動多種資料導向的應用程式與資訊科技（"IT"）需求。透過我們的部落格與透明文化，我們已建立數百萬讀者與品牌忠誠粉絲的社羣。我們的直接銷售活動、通路與技術合作夥伴，以及來自品牌忠誠粉絲社羣的推薦，加上我們極具效率且自服務的客戶獲取模式，使我們能吸引超過500,000位客戶，截至2025年12月31日，且我們的直接銷售活動歷來協助我們獲取較大型的客戶，包括領先的新型雲端平台，透過我們的Powered by Backblaze計畫。隨著我們向上遊市場進展，我們預期直接銷售活動將越來越有助於獲取這些類型的客戶。我們的客戶使用我們的Backblaze Storage Cloud平台，在超過175個國家儲存與保護其資料，總計約有50億GB的資料儲存量。

在成立之初，Backblaze的目標是大幅簡化儲存、使用與保護資料的過程。在接下來的幾年中，我們致力於去除傳統雲端服務供應商與傳統內部部署系統供應商服務中常見的複雜性。今天，我們相信我們的解決方案因其效能與成本效益而有所區別，同時也提供可靠性與易用性。我們的策略聚焦於一組專注的儲存使用場景，並參與開放雲端生態系統，我們相信這使我們能優先考慮具有AI模型建構者與使用我們Powered by Backblaze計畫的新型雲端平台等資料密集型工作負載的機會。除了這些新興機會，我們持續擴大業務與機會，與應用儲存解決方案的開發者合作，同時持續服務我們的基礎使用場景，包括媒體與娛樂以及網路韌性。最後，我們持續投資於我們的自服務用戶羣，讓實驗AI的開發者能在我們的儲存平台上實驗與成長。

Backblaze Storage Cloud為我們的雲端服務提供核心平台，設計用以提供高性能、安全、可靠的物件儲存，規模達艾字位（exabyte）。目前，該平台管理超過1兆個檔案，這些檔案可按需存取，並設計用以高效擴充以應對日益增長的企業工作負載與AI驅動的資料需求。Backblaze Storage Cloud的關鍵驅動因素是其專屬的全球規模系統與軟體架構，用以管理我們的全球物理基礎建設，包括數百萬個硬碟，分佈在多個資料中心。

網際網路規模的軟體層接收、儲存並交付全球客戶的資料，智能地根據容量與需求分配儲存空間，以維持大規模的可用性與耐久性。在管理不斷增長的資料量，同時在越來越大的硬碟上維持耐久性、可用性與吞吐量方面，這是一個高度複雜的過程。我們相信持續投資於開發效能優化、效率改進、運營支援及其他軟體創新，能提升我們有效利用硬體並以成本效益擴充的能力。除了這些核心流程，此軟體架構還管理負載平衡、快取、刪除、計費及其他必要的
功能，為數百萬位客戶服務。我們程式碼庫的定期更新進一步強化這些功能，並提升我們基礎建設即服務平台（"IaaS"）的整體效能。

我們的資料倉庫架構透過專屬及其他演算法，為客戶資料的儲存建立冗餘。我們的軟體將每個上傳的客戶檔案分割成多個資料部分，加入多個冗餘部分，並將這些部分儲存在不同伺服器的離散硬碟上。因此，即使部分資料完全遺失或離線，我們仍能從剩餘的部分重建客戶資料，以確保耐久性與可用性。我們的全球分散式儲存平台也為客戶提供多區域地理選擇，包括美國東部與西部海岸地區，以及加拿大與歐洲地區，提供不同需求的靈活性，包括地緣政治考量、法規要求與效能優化。
隨著客戶的資料需求成長，我們尋求持續且順利地部署額外基礎建設，並利用財務租賃以使資本部署與平台擴充需求對齊。這些持續的投資旨在支持高持續吞吐量與價格相對，同時表現出我們相信與競爭對手錶現相當或更高的水平，包括多種檔案大小與並發配置的上傳與下載吞吐量。我們定期發佈效能測試結果與我們的效能測試方法，以提高透明度並使與其他雲端儲存供應商進行對比的基準測試成為可能。
透過我們的 Backblaze Storage Cloud 平台，我們提供兩種主要服務，B2 Cloud Storage 與 Computer Backup，這些服務旨在讓客戶能以靈活且成本效益的方式儲存、使用並保護其資料。這些服務採用相同的核心軟體架構，使我們能為廣泛的客戶羣，從個人用戶到大型企業，提供一致的效能、安全性與可靠性。

B2 Cloud Storage 讓客戶能直接存取 Backblaze Storage Cloud 平台，使其能儲存、使用並保護資料，適用於廣泛的應用場景。用戶可透過產業標準與原生的應用程式程式設計介面、軟體開發工具包、我們的網頁介面，或數百種第三方整合方式存取此平台。B2 Cloud Storage 提供廣泛的存取選項，使應用場景更加多元，包括開發者與合作夥伴，他們可將儲存功能整合至其技術堆疊中，或在其平台之上建立自有解決方案。客戶也會將其核心資料系統的備份層級儲存至 Backblaze Storage Cloud 平台，包括內部部署與虛擬機器伺服器及其他高容量儲存裝置。

企業正日益將 B2 Cloud Storage，包括我們的高吞吐量高階服務 B2 Overdrive，整合至人工智慧（"AI"）與機器學習（"ML"）工作流程中，確保資料可存取性、可擴展性與高效能的網路表現。從原始資料的收集與處理，到模型訓練與推論，B2 Cloud Storage 被設計為管理大量資料集的可靠基礎，使資料能順暢地傳輸至圖形處理單元（"GPU"）叢集，優化儲存以處理 AI 產生的輸出，並提供成本效益且可擴展的儲存方案，用於監控與日誌。B2 Overdrive 建立在 B2 Cloud Storage 的基礎上，並包含最高達 1Tbps 的吞吐量、無限免費出站流量，以及私人網路支援，設計為讓客戶能在不影響效能的前提下運行資料密集型工作負載，以控制成本。這種靈活性讓客戶能運用最佳的計算 GPU 服務，而無需與供應商綁定，並大幅降低資料傳輸成本，最大化資源使用率，並減少總體費用。

客戶將 B2 Cloud Storage 用於其他廣泛的應用場景，包括公有雲、混合雲與多雲資料儲存；應用程式開發與 DevOps；內容分發與邊緣計算；安全性與勒索軟體防護；媒體管理；備份、歸檔與磁帶取代；以及物聯網（例如：儲存監控系統、自動駕駛車輛與智慧裝置的資料）。在 AI 與資料密集型工作負載常見的多雲環境中，客戶經常在不同雲服務供應商之間移動大量資料，這可能造成運營複雜性，並導致顯著的資料出站費用。B2 Cloud Storage 的開放平台與標準免費出站流量（最高為儲存資料的 3 倍）被設計為讓客戶能建立成本效益高的多雲架構，並在多樣化的雲環境中順暢地協調資料。
B2 Cloud Storage 以 IaaS 模式運作，讓客戶能根據需求彈性調整規模，並以按使用量計費的方式，或購買容量或簽訂承諾合約以獲得更高的預測性。
我們的 Computer Backup 雲端服務解決方案能以連續且自動化的方式備份筆記型電腦、桌上型電腦與外接硬碟。無論是家用電腦或企業的整體機器羣組，客戶都能備份幾乎無限的檔案數量，而不受容量或速度限制。Computer Backup 提供透明且統一的定價方案，讓客戶能持續備份資料，並以訂閱制的軟體即服務（"SaaS"）模式提供。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們的合併財務報表及相關附註說明一併閱讀，內容包含於本年度報表 10-K 的「第二部分 — 第 8 項 財務報表及補充資料」。本討論，特別是關於我們未來營運成果或財務狀況、商業策略與計畫，以及管理階層未來營運目標的資訊，包含風險與不確定性，如「特別說明前瞻性陳述」標題下所述，於「第一部分 — 第 1A 項 風險因素」中說明。請審閱「風險因素」標題下的揭露，以瞭解可能導致我們實際結果與這些前瞻性陳述中所描述或暗示的結果有重大差異的重要因素。我們的歷史結果並不一定代表未來任何期間的結果。除非文意另有明確要求，否則本報告中所有提及「Backblaze」、「本公司」、「我們」、「我們的」、「我們」或類似詞彙，均指 Backblaze, Inc. 及其合併子公司。

以下為我們 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況及營運成果與 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況及營運成果的比較分析。有關我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況及營運成果與 2023 年 12 月 31 日財務狀況及營運成果的比較分析，請參閱我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日年度報表 10-K 的「第二部分，第 7 項」，該報表於 2025 年 3 月 11 日向 SEC 提交。
我們是一家高績效的雲端儲存平台，專為人工智慧（"AI"）時代及廣泛的現代雲端工作負載設計，旨在協助客戶解決複雜的儲存需求，透過降低鎖定、複雜性與成本的門檻。我們的使命是協助客戶成功，解決他們最困難的資料儲存挑戰。我們透過我們專為目的設計、網際網路規模的軟體基礎設施來實現此使命，這對全球資料中心與計算基礎設施的建設至關重要。

我們透過專為目的設計、網際網路規模的軟體基礎設施，並建於一般性硬體之上，提供雲端服務。我們相信，透過提供一個針對價格與效能比例進行優化、以效率為工程設計，並以可預測價格提供的雲端儲存解決方案，我們大幅降低儲存、使用與保護資料的成本、複雜性與煩惱，並使客戶能專注於其核心業務運作。客戶使用我們的服務來支援其 AI 工作流程，確保其組織的網路韌性，簡化其媒體工作流程，並啟動多種其他資料導向的應用程式與資訊科技（"IT"）需求。透過我們的部落格與透明文化，我們已建立了一個數百萬讀者與品牌忠誠粉絲的社羣。我們的直接銷售活動、通路與科技夥伴，以及來自品牌忠誠粉絲社羣的推薦，加上我們高度效率且自服務的客戶獲取模式，使我們能吸引超過 500,000 名客戶，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，而我們的直接銷售活動歷來協助我們獲取較大型的客戶，包括透過我們的 Powered by Backblaze 程式所服務的領導性新雲端平台。隨著我們向上遊市場發展，我們預期我們的直接銷售活動將越來越有助於獲取這些類型的客戶。我們的客戶使用我們的 Backblaze Storage Cloud 平台，在超過 175 個國家儲存與保護其資料，總計約有 50 億 gigabytes 的資料儲存量。

我們的 Backblaze Storage Cloud 提供一個平台，作為我們 B2 雲端儲存基礎設施即服務（"IaaS"）方案、我們的 B2 Overdrive 高效能 IaaS 方案、我們的 Powered by Backblaze 白標 IaaS 方案，以及我們的 Computer Backup 軟體即服務（"SaaS"）方案的基礎。B2 雲端儲存使客戶能儲存資料、開發者能建立應用程式，以及夥伴能擴展其使用案例。此雲端服務中儲存的資料量可根據需求上漲或下降，主要以按使用量計費為主，或可根據容量或承諾合約計費，以獲得更高的預測性。B2 Overdrive 建立在 B2 雲端儲存的基礎上。它能支援 AI 與資料驅動的工作負載，最高達 1Tbps 的吞吐量，無限免費出站流量，並支援私人網路。Powered by Backblaze 也建立在 B2 雲端儲存的基礎上。它使新雲端與應用程式平台能透過 Backblaze 合作夥伴 API 與自訂域名（CNAME）技術，強化現有產品或擴展其產品組合。Computer Backup 會自動備份筆記型電腦與桌上型電腦的資料，供企業與個人使用。此雲端備份服務提供易於理解的基本上為固定費用的計費方式，以持續備份幾乎無限的資料量。
我們專注於專業儲存與一個開放的雲端生態系統，與廣泛的夥伴整合。持續投資於我們的技術平台與相關功能，已推動客戶、社羣與產品里程碑。從 2024 年第二季開始，我們啟動了一項市場推廣轉型，積極推動公司向上遊市場發展，這已體現在與總合約價值超過 1.0 百萬美元的多筆交易簽約，以及 B2 雲端儲存的營收成長為 2025 年 12 月 31 日相比 2024 年成長 26%。

為支持我們向上遊市場擴張與不斷演進的客戶需求，我們最近推出了 B2 Overdrive，這是我們高價位、超高吞吐量的雲端儲存解決方案，專為資料密集型工作負載設計，包括 AI 與機器學習訓練、大規模分析、高效能計算與媒體處理。我們也推出了一套企業網路安全功能，包括 AI 驅動的異常警示、強制多因素驗證、桶位存取日誌記錄，以及企業網路控制檯，簡化複雜環境中的基於角色的行政控制，以協助網路安全與帳戶管理。這些新產品擴大了我們在企業與 AI 驅動客戶中的可接觸市場，並為進一步創新奠定基礎，以為這些客戶創造差異化的價值。
2025 年 6 月 4 日，我們與 Citizens Bank, N.A. 籤訂信貸協議，設立總借款額最高為 20.0 百萬美元的高級 secured 循環信貸設施，用於一般企業用途及營運資金需求。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司在該設施下無任何未償還貸款。
2025 重整與轉型計畫

2025年11月，我們啟動了一項重整與轉型計畫，主要目的是提高效率並強化銷售與行銷功能，以支持我們的市場進入策略（"2025 重整與轉型計畫"）。2025 重整與轉型計畫包括資源重新配置、銷售與行銷策略與流程的重新設計，以及其他企業行動。在2025年12月31日為結業年度，我們產生了約2.5百萬美元的費用，包括員工離職費用、與我們退出總部辦公室設施相關的減損費用，以及其他轉型費用。我們預期在2027年第一季前，產生額外約4.7百萬至7.5百萬美元的費用，此時2025重整計畫預期完成。這些費用包括預估員工離職費用約0.8百萬至1.2百萬美元，以及其他業務轉型費用。
2025年8月，我們的董事會批准了一項股票回購計畫，授權我們在2026年8月1日前，回購最高10.0百萬美元的A類普通股。此計畫旨在抵消因股票報酬而產生的稀釋。回購資金將來自員工股票選擇權行權所得，以及2021年員工股票購買計畫下的員工投資款項。
我們的解決方案旨在服務從個人與小型企業到各行業大型企業的廣大客戶羣。我們的解決方案吸引那些尋求易於使用且成本效益高的解決方案的客戶，同時也提供可靠性與性能。我們的商業模式由一個高度高效的雲端儲存平台支撐，該平台建於專有軟體與標準硬體之上，使我們能夠提供可預測的價格與可擴展的價格性能比。我們的兩大主要雲端服務為B2雲端儲存與電腦備份，這兩者共同讓客戶能在廣泛的應用場景中儲存、使用與保護其資料。
•B2雲端儲存讓客戶能儲存與管理資料，用於從備份與歸檔到應用程式儲存、勒索軟體防護以及AI/ML工作負載等多種應用場景。B2雲端儲存運作於IaaS模式，讓客戶能根據使用量動態擴充，按使用付費，或購買容量或簽訂承諾合約以獲得更高的預測性。除了我們標準的B2雲端儲存服務外，我們還提供B2 Overdrive，這是一項高階高性能儲存選項，專為資料密集型與AI驅動的工作負載設計，
需要高持續吞吐量與低延遲。開發者與夥伴可以將我們的儲存嵌入其應用程式中，而企業客戶則使用B2雲端儲存來支援大規模、資料密集型的工作流程。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
本公司有累積虧損的歷史，且在可預見的未來，我們不預期會獲利。
我們參與的市場競爭激烈，若我們無法有效競爭，將會對營運結果造成損害。
若發生重大服務中斷或資料遺失，或客戶資料無法即時取得，可能損害本公司聲譽，並對業務及營運結果造成不利影響。
若本公司無法維持品牌與聲譽，將可能對業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
若本公司資訊科技系統，包括客戶資料遭入侵或遭受網路安全攻擊，將可能損害聲譽與業務。
若本公司無法以具成本效益的方式吸引並留住客戶，將對營業收入與營運結果造成不利影響。
若我們無法成功提升、新增功能或修改我們的雲端服務，將可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
我們軟體或硬體的嚴重缺陷或錯誤可能對本公司業務造成負面影響，損害本公司聲譽，導致本公司產生重大成本，並對本公司銷售雲端服務的能力造成負面影響。
若我們無法有效管理我們的員工及運營需求，將可能對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司業務可能因未能有效管理資料中心容量及與資料中心空間相關的成本而受到重大損害。
本公司業務依賴我們維持並增加來自客戶的收入，若我們無法做到，將對本公司收入及運營結果造成不利影響。
若我們針對不同類型的客戶進行目標行銷，可能面臨增加的壓力與挑戰，對本公司業務與運營造成不利影響。
使用我們雲端服務所儲存的資料可能使本公司面臨負面宣傳、法律責任，並損害本公司業務。
本公司每季的營運結果可能出現顯著波動，且可能無法完全反映本公司業務的實際表現。
我們依賴關鍵人員的表現，包括我們的管理階層及其他關鍵員工，若失去其中一位或多位人員，或失去大量團隊成員，可能會對我們的業務造成損害。
若無法吸引並留住更多合格人才，可能會妨礙我們執行業務策略。
我們的企業文化已為我們的成功做出貢獻，若在成長過程中無法維持此文化，可能會失去該文化所培養的創新、創造力與團隊合作精神，進而對我們的業務造成損害。
我們的營運以及我們的客戶、供應商與合作夥伴在美國境外的營運，會面臨更高的營運、法規與經濟風險，這些風險可能會影響我們的營運成果。
paragraphs: 某些因素可能會對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。您應謹慎考量下列所描述之風險與不確定性，並配合本年度10-K表報表中所有其他資訊，包括標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」之部分，以及本公司合併財務報表與附註說明，內容載於本年度10-K表報表其他處。本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景亦可能因目前未為本公司所知悉，或本公司目前認為非屬重大之風險與不確定性而受到損害。若上述任何風險實際發生，可能會對本公司之業務、財務狀況、流動性、營運成果及本公司A類普通股之市場價格產生重大不利影響。
以下為使投資本公司A類普通股成為投機性或風險性投資之主要因素之摘要。重要的是，此摘要並未涵蓋本公司所面臨之所有風險。本公司執行業務策略之能力，受許多風險影響，如後續標題為「風險因素」之部分所更詳細說明。這些風險包括但不限於：
